scope: Actual viewer module executed in Node vm with simulated DOM, Image decode and metadata fetch; no native browser, network, GL context or mobile device.

cases.name: Initial image decode commits matching image, UI values, URL and raw model links
Image decode failure leaves current model image, label and download URL unchanged
Newest successful route wins across actual viewer DOM and history
Late old-variant metadata cannot relabel dimensions or alter final download identity
Failed Back/Forward image restores URL to the retained successful content
Successful Back/Forward restores route without pushing a new history entry
Module/3D initialization failure leaves static image and independent route intact
Static keyboard view cycling and Escape use the same independent state controller
Initial missing image does not enable 3D or fabricate a committed asset
